items.title: Ackman adds Netflix, Visa and Mastercard in portfolio revamp
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bill Ackman disclosed six new portfolio holdings on Thursday, including Netflix, Visa, and Mastercard, representing his largest portfolio restructuring in several years.

items.title: Ackman unveils six new investments including Netflix, Visa, Mastercard in biggest portfolio overhaul in years
items.summary: Bill Ackman unveiled six new holdings including Netflix, Visa and Mastercard, marking the billionaire investor's biggest portfolio overhaul in years.  Ackman said on Thursday he acquired shares ‌starting in the second quarter that will be held in his investment funds including his newest offering ‌Pershing Square USA, which was listed on the New York Stock Exchange in April.  Along with Netflix, which Ackman held briefly in 2022 before selling ​at a loss, his funds are also investing in eye care firm Alcon, exchange operator Intercontinental Exchange and financial data provider S&P Global.

items.title: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square buys Netflix, 5 other stocks in 2026
